scope: Canonical owners and invariants for the October 17 tab review; expand as related features are maintained.

features.name: Story Console
features.purpose: Compose chapters and resolve keyword rewards
features.expectedBehavior: GM attachment loading appends and opens new tabs; existing chapters, keywords and shops remain isolated.

features.name: Location attachments
features.purpose: Reuse saved content at planet and region hexes
features.expectedBehavior: Only GM sees loaders. NPC, surface encounter and Story files persist privately; arrival never auto-loads.

features.name: Campaign navigation
features.purpose: Browse named map hierarchy and locate the party
features.expectedBehavior: All map levels enlarge to viewport; ancestor maps retain party location; GM painting tools remain accessible.

features.name: Character relocation
features.purpose: GM moves one PC or NPC to a named location
features.expectedBehavior: GM-only, preserves other characters, persists private location data and projects each PC own view; blocked during active combat.

features.name: Campaign shops
features.expectedBehavior: Everything begins inactive, always uses standard catalog prices and cannot be deleted; ordinary shops retain existing controls.

features.name: Private inbox
features.purpose: Share mail layout and campaign recipient selection
features.expectedBehavior: No self-message or forged sender; PC notes visible only to recipient and GM; preserve notification actions.

features.name: Ship walking and console
features.purpose: Continuous keyboard routes and consistent console exit
features.expectedBehavior: Walking retains final facing; gold console control remains centered and becomes red Exit Console while open.

features.name: Character statistics
features.purpose: Track confirmed skill and unmodified dice results
features.expectedBehavior: Receipt deduplication; attribute values use resolved dice before bonuses; manual totals without separate dice are excluded from attribute averages.
